exposure: Number of HIE cases admitted to NICU
Number of HIE cases admitted to NICU (<50, 50-100, >100)

Therapeutic hypothermia (TH) type: no TH, TH using servo-controlled devices (SCDs), passive TH by exposing neonates to NICU's air-conditioned ambient temperature with/without the use of cooled gel packs (P±CGPs)
cohort: 2,761 late-preterm and term neonates (gestation of ≥35 weeks) without major malformations and diagnosed with hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy (HIE)
finding: Moderate/severe HIE and receiving passive/no TH were among the risk factors associated with mortality in late-preterm and term neonates with HIE.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was a significant risk factor associated with mortality.
